title: Fraggy's Minecraft Reimagined
description: A simple Minecraft modpack focusing on performance and overall gameplay/graphics enhancements.
body:
-Disclaimer-

This modpack is a fusion of Fabulously Optimized and many more quality of life mods so the base modpack is Fabulously Optimized.

-Performance-

Fabulously Optimized is faster than competing game clients, thanks to modern performance mods like Sodium, Lithium, and others. The bundled mods have been carefully selected to be safe in your worlds and provide noticeable speed benefits on any device.

-OptiFine Parity-

This modpack supports most OptiFine features, including shaders, connected textures, and zoom. If your resource pack states "OptiFine required," it will probably function here as well.

-Works everywhere-

This modpack does not include content mods, so you can play on any world or server. While you can use any game launcher to play the pack, I've added specific ones that offer the best experience.

-Built on Fabric-

Fabulously Optimized uses the Fabric mod loader, which is lightweight, fast, and supports a lot of mods.

I am improving this modpack everyday so if you have any issues or you want to give any suggestion you can join this discord server '[Discord](https://discord.gg/JeJRRP38Un)'
